thread:
Maya (Mktg): FYI the handoff tile shows a recurring bump of unassigned leads between 20:00-02:00 UTC, mostly EMEA and LATAM.
Owen - SalesOps: seen it. enrichment often returns late or 429s; our RR rule requires `company.segment` so leads stay unowned.
Priya CS: impact is noisy conversion metrics in the morning because MQLs come in as unowned then later assigned. we should avoid polluting velocity dashboards.
Maya (Mktg): proposal: add an "evening window" fallback that runs after a 12m delay and assigns to segmented night pools, plus a property `fallback_source=evening-window` for filtering.
Owen - SalesOps: agree. plan: HubSpot workflow Delay(12m) -> If owner IS_EMPTY AND timezone IN (EMEA,LATAM) -> assign owner = segment-based-night-pool; set inbound_fallback=true; set fallback_ts. mirror in SFDC.
Priya CS: add TTL reassign webhook so enrichment can swap to real owner and set inbound_fallback=false. also exclude fallback-assigned leads from MQL conversion rate until validated.
Euler Eng Bot: enrichment queue report: current overnight throttle = 50r/s with burst 200; increasing briefly is possible but will cost.
Owen - SalesOps: rollout: HS sandbox -> SFDC flow -> canary UK+BR for 48h -> monitor: unassigned_count, fallback_rate, time_to_real_owner, manual_reassigns. add alert to #sdr-ops if fallback_rate > 5% for 3h.
Maya (Mktg): I'll update the SDR playbook with handling guidance and schedule a 7-day post-canary review.
Priya CS: sounds good. keep an eye on false positives and quality.
Owen - SalesOps: drafting HS workflow now, will drop JSON here for review. :eyes:
Maya (Mktg): thanks, team. small change should avoid a lot of morning triage. :raised_hands:
